findings.place: Opening word, first line
findings.evidence: Crop 01: initial upright has a long baseline and an extended roof; a second tall descending stroke has a short detached horizontal beside its upper part. The final low run ends in a downward hook. These strokes support Item as the first reading, while the compressed internal and final letters remain unresolved. The following comma is separate.

findings.place: Relation between X and S-star
findings.evidence: Crop 03: a nearly horizontal shaft ends in a thickened tip and a short downward barb. The crop does not reveal a matching upper arm forming a complete arrowhead. The horizontal-stroke reading remains first; an intended right arrow remains possible.
findings.mathematical_note: The adjacent words application and surjective suggest an arrow as a reading cue. That cue did not replace the incomplete visible head.

findings.place: Two word groups immediately before images
findings.evidence: Crop 04: two separate groups precede the dotted beginning of images. The first begins with a tall loop and a low terminal run. The second begins with a small closed loop and an upright rising above it, then runs rightward to a downward terminal. I read les des; both groups are live and uncancelled.
findings.mathematical_note: The extra article-like group is preserved despite the sentence construction.

findings.place: Comma after application

notes.text: The upper paragraph concerns the traces of binary decompositions on the written set S-star = S amalg A-prime, then a surjective application and its indexed family of nonempty sets. It records the two families U_s and E_a. The relation sign after X and the small high mark in the family index remain graphical uncertainties. The words application and surjective, and the clearer S-star occurrences, were mathematical reading cues only.

The author explicitly writes that the case of empty U_s and E_a is “à examiner avec plus de soin”, then “il donne néanmoins ce qu'on veut”. The paragraph cites the labels (*) and (**) and uses the handwritten form sss twice. The spelling stricte and the phrase “ceci (plus fort que (**))” are preserved. No proof of the stated claims was checked.

The final labelled condition contains a visible revision: cancelled tel is accompanied by live interlinear et; the cancelled continuation que U_s=empty-set, et has the inserted edge phrase above it. The final display contains the two not-equal/empty-set comparisons separated by a reduced mark read first as ou. Its disjunctive role supplied a reading cue but the glyph remains uncertain.

The sheet contains no visible title or date and no authorial page number. The light lower-left 29 is retained as archive numbering in a TeX comment. No diagram, drawing, independent margin note, or typed substrate was observed.

workflow_feedback: Read only the assigned brief, notation table, packet, C, H, page-specific C context and doubt index, supplied preambles, and the three assigned scan images. No other pages, readers, main decisions, OCR, text recognition, external research, or compilation were used.

Whole image opened once for layout. Each supplied half opened once and read line by line. All twelve prepared crops were viewed exactly once. Each crop serves a locus still open after the halves; crop 07 coherently covers the small family index, attached insertion and cancelled à.

Crop bounds were checked against the 1693 by 2365 source before extraction. Every crop was enlarged to 3000 pixels wide with LANCZOS, autocontrast and UnsharpMask. No rotation was necessary. No target locus was clipped or recropped; surrounding context is intentionally truncated at crop boundaries.
Complete reading.tex was saved immediately after image reading, before return.json was composed. Only the R2 directory was written.
All thirteen C doubts have retained or resolved findings. Resolving a C primary reading is reported separately from a primary-reading error; no C primary reading was changed.

H's preamble and explicit page note were read. H's emphasis macro was treated as authorial underlining where stated; no finding was created from macro spelling alone. Its page note acknowledging an interlinear attachment was taken into account, while its extra words were collated against the visible insertion.
The only mathematical work was using local statement structure as a reading cue. No proof check, independent re-proof, computation or formal verification was performed, so check_events is empty.
